subject: Acme procurement next steps: PO vs card, SOC 2, and marketplace
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmecorp.com>, Tom Rivera <trivera@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme procurement next steps: PO vs card, SOC 2, and marketplace

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the thoughtful walkthrough of Acme's use case and timeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the procurement path: 

Recap from today's discovery:
- Primary integration is for customer support summarization (prod traffic expected in Q4).
- Security/compliance gating: your InfoSec team needs SOC 2 evidence and a signed DPA before production access.
- Procurement path: likely PO (preferred by your finance team) but open to card for pilots.
- Marketplace: you asked whether we’re on AWS Marketplace — currently we have an integration in progress; may not be ready for your procurement cutover.

Next steps / asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether Acme will purchase via PO (Net30/Net60) or if a credit card will be used for the pilot? If PO, please share the vendor onboarding contact and any vendor form (I can loop Legal).
2) InfoSec said they will either accept our SOC 2 report + standard DPA or send a vendor security questionnaire. If they send a questionnaire, will completion of that be a gating dependency in addition to SOC 2/DPA?
3) Do you have a target signature/PO date we should aim for?

I've attached our standard DPA and a link to our SOC 2 report for your review. If helpful, Monica (cc'd) can review any vendor onboarding paperwork or redlines. Sean (cc'd) will follow up on commercial questions and pricing cadence.

Attachments: redwood-dpa-v1.pdf
Links: https://redwood.app/security/soc2-report

Thanks — happy to hop back on a quick call with procurement if that accelerates things.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <trivera@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme procurement next steps: PO vs card, SOC 2, and marketplace

Hi Marissa —

Great to connect yesterday. Quick answers below: 

1) Procurement preference: PO. For pilot we might be able to use a corporate card, but the production contract will be via PO. Our standard cadence is Net30; Net60 requires CFO approval and is uncommon.
2) InfoSec: they will want to review your SOC 2 report. They typically require either a completed security questionnaire (we use a standard vendor security questionnaire) or SOC 2 + executed DPA. If the questionnaire is requested, it will be a gating item for Prod.
3) Timeline: our target for vendor onboarding and PO issuance is end of August. That said, if we can get the DPA signed and the SOC2 evidence in the next 2–3 weeks, procurement can prioritize it.

Attaching our vendor onboarding form for your Legal/Finance to complete: acme-vendor-onboarding.pdf

Marketplace: not required for this procurement; we can revisit after initial deployment.

CCing Tom (IT) in case he wants to add anything on the InfoSec side.

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Procurement Lead
Acme Corp
lisa.chen@acmecorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-17T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Acme procurement next steps: PO vs card, SOC 2, and marketplace

Sean / Monica —

Forwarding Lisa's reply. Key asks: they prefer PO (Net30 typical), InfoSec will want SOC2 + DPA or a completed questionnaire (which would be gating for Prod). Target PO by end of August, but can accelerate if we get DPA + SOC2 in 2–3 weeks.

Monica: can you review our DPA (attached) and let me know if you expect any significant redlines relative to Acme's vendor onboarding form? If you can return a redline I can share back to Lisa. 
Sean: can you prepare a short commercial note (recommended list price, pilot vs prod SKUs, any recommended uplift for enterprise PO) so I can include in procurement call?

Attachments forwarded: acme-vendor-onboarding.pdf

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min procurement/InfoSec alignment if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme procurement next steps: PO vs card, SOC 2, and marketplace

Thanks for the ping — reviewed Acme's onboarding form and our DPA. High-level:

- DPA: fine with one minor redline around data retention/return of customer data. I'll send a redlined PDF back (redwood-dpa-v1-redline.pdf).
- Vendor onboarding form: standard asks (W9, tax info, vendor contact) — Finance can complete once Legal signs DPA.
- Payment terms: we can accept PO Net30 for this deal. Net60 would need Finance/CFO approval; likely slower.
- Security questionnaire: Monica (Legal) recommends we offer to complete the questionnaire in parallel, but emphasize SOC 2 + signed DPA are the primary gating items. If they require a full questionnaire before signing anything, ask them to flag the specific sections that are blocking so we can prioritize responses.

I'll attach the redlined DPA and a short note for Finance on who to contact for W9/vendor setup. If you'd like, I can draft a 1-page vendor response to the typical Acme questionnaire (to speed the process).

Attachments: redwood-dpa-v1-redline.pdf
Link: https://redwood.app/security/soc2-report

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
